Next Steps

  1. Log in to your APEX Workspace, e.g. https://<your-host>/ords/r/apex/workspace-sign-in
  2. Navigate to SQL Workshop → SQL Scripts → Upload
  3. Upload the install script, name it install-rest-compile, and confirm
  4. Run the script, then open the detail view of the run to see the output
  5. The output contains REST_SQL_URL, REST_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL, and REST_OAUTH_BASIC_B64

The connection parameters you entered during initialization are already saved in your workspace settings.
Use dbFlux: Show REST Compile Installation Guide at any time to revisit these instructions.

Have fun developing with dbFlux.

You can find more documentation on github at: https://github.com/MaikMichel/dbFlux
